647.t: Domaine Solio — gîte and glamping in the Ardèche, 13 ha
647.d: A 3-star gîte for 10 and a safari tent for 5, alone on 13 hectares of meadow and forest in Satillieu, Ardèche. Farm animals, pool, Nordic bath.

651.t: The Estate — 13 hectares in the Ardèche verte
651.d: 13 hectares of meadow and forest in Satillieu, a 2 km walking loop, and donkeys, goats and sheep that children can approach freely.

652.d: A 3-star gîte for 10 in Satillieu: 4 bedrooms, 2 shower rooms, a wood stove and a terrace facing the mountains, on a 13-hectare estate.

653.t: L’Estiva — glamping safari tent in the Ardèche
653.d: A safari tent for 5 on a wooden deck in the goat meadow. Private shower room, starry skies, no wifi, no neighbours. Open April to mid-October.

650.t: Things to do in the Ardèche verte, near Satillieu
